theorems.name: Submission.cmr_vr_jordan_decomposition
theorems.statement: ∀ (X : Type) [TopologicalSpace X] (Λ : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap X ℝ →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ), (∀ K : Set X, IsCompact K → ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ f : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap X ℝ, tsupport f ⊆ K → (∀ x, |f x| ≤ 1) → |Λ f| ≤ M) → ∃ Λ₁ Λ₂ : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap X ℝ →ₚ[ℝ] ℝ, ∀ f : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap X ℝ, Λ f = Λ₁ f - Λ₂ f
